1. Revision purpose
Version 1.1 updates the synthetic powertrain baseline to introduce cruise control integration, renamed thermal
terminology, and revised timing. It is intended for revision-comparison testing.

5. Updated behaviour
VehicleStateManager publishes VehicleSpeed_kph every 10 ms. CruiseControlManager consumes vehicle speed and
produces CruiseTorque_Nm. TorqueArbitrator selects between driver demand and cruise demand according to
CruiseState and driver override.
6. Known review observation
The input If_DriverOverride is referenced by CruiseControlManager but is intentionally not defined in this revision. This
controlled defect is included for completeness-check evaluation.
7. Approval note
This is a synthetic revision comparison artifact. It shall not be treated as an authoritative vehicle architecture.
